user_story: User Story 1 - Submit and track a prior authorization
scenario_text: Given a provider submits a PA request, When the payer supports FHIR PAS, Then the request is sent as a $submit bundle.
note: Contract test suite run against the payer sandbox; all cases green.

user_story: User Story 1 - Submit and track a prior authorization
scenario_text: Given the payer has no FHIR support, When a request is submitted, Then it is routed over X12 278 instead.
note: Implementation reviewed and appears to satisfy this; no automated test run observed for the X12 fallback path.

user_story: User Story 2 - Status tracker and notifications
scenario_text: Given a status change arrives from the payer, When it is processed, Then the provider sees it in the tracker within 60 seconds.
note: Contract test run; tracker update observed at ~140s under load, exceeds the 60s target.

user_story: User Story 2 - Status tracker and notifications
scenario_text: Given a denial reason code is received, When displayed to the provider, Then it shows a plain-language explanation, not just the code.
